settings.title: Companion Settings
settings.languageDesc: Select your preferred language. Official in-game names and descriptions are loaded directly from Big Ambitions.
settings.themeDesc: Choose Light, Dark, or follow your operating system setting.
settings.uncleFredBubbleDesc: Show the floating Uncle Fred chat button. Turn it off to keep him out of the way.
settings.privacyStatement: All game data stays on your machine. The mod serves telemetry only over localhost, and anything sent to us (bug or suggestion reports) leaves only when you press Send.
settings.clearCacheDesc: Clears cached telemetry and session data - use this if the app shows stale info after an update. Your settings are kept.
settings.voiceEngineNote: Voice generation is currently exclusively available in English.
settings.keepAwakeDesc: Prevents screen sleep while using as a secondary monitor companion.
settings.autoPauseDesc: Pauses live telemetry updates when browser tab is inactive to save system resources.
settings.stutterWarning: May cause stutter, especially on large saves.
settings.keepAwakeDesc2: Prevents monitor sleep when used on a second display.
settings.notifSoundDesc: Play a short chime when a new alert appears.
settings.notifBannersDesc: Show the top-center toast when a new alert appears.
settings.doNotDisturbDesc: Silence pop-ups and sound. Alerts still appear in the notification feed.
settings.criticalOnlyDesc: Keep warnings (low stock, morale) in the feed; only stockouts and unstaffed stores pop up or chime.
settings.cleanlinessDesc: Warn when a store drops below a healthy cleanliness level.
settings.storeLowStockDesc: Warn when a store product is expected to run out within this many hours while the store is open.
settings.warehouseRunwayDesc: Warn when a stocked warehouse product drops below this many days of runway. Critical alerts fire at 2 days or less. Off disables all warehouse runway alerts.
settings.ignoreManufacturedStockDesc: Skip warehouse runway warnings for finished goods a depot manufactures itself, since the production lines replenish them. Purchased stock still warns.
settings.emptyShelfDesc: Show alerts for products that are completely out of stock while the store is open.
settings.unattendedOpenDesc: Warn if a store is open with no cashiers scheduled.
settings.workerFatigueDesc: Warn when an employee's satisfaction drops below 70%.
settings.overnightLiquidityDesc: Alert if midnight taxes exceed 50% of available cash.
settings.syncModeHint: Choose how often live telemetry updates. Faster sync feels more responsive but uses more resources.
settings.hourlyModeNote: Syncs once per in-game hour. Data stays frozen between syncs.
settings.dailyModeNote: Syncs once per in-game day at midnight. Data stays frozen between syncs.

tips: Keep 100% customer service and interior rating. Happy customers spend up to 20% more without flinching.
Check the market ceiling on your pricing tab - people in Midtown pay top dollar.
Taxes hit every Sunday at midnight. Don't go negative or loan interest will bleed you dry.
Traffic Index matters more than store size. A small 15-capacity store on a 100-traffic corner beats a dead avenue.
Don't hire full-time workers if you're open 8 hours a day. Part-time shifts keep payroll lean.
Commercial real estate is passive gold. Once you own the building, rent expense drops to zero.
Revenue is vanity, profit is sanity, but cash flow is king, kid.

about.title: Where the data comes from
about.subtitle: Nothing here is crowdsourced, estimated, or copied from a wiki. The compendium is read from the game's own files, and the live numbers come straight from your running save.
about.provenanceTitle: From the game to the app
about.provenanceIntro: Three steps turn the game's raw records into the typed data this site runs on.
about.prov1Desc: Big Ambitions ships managed C# assemblies (BigAmbitions.dll, plus .Items, .Characters and .Neighborhoods). We read the real data classes and logic from them, so prices, schedules and formulas are the game's own, not approximations.
about.prov2Desc: A Python pipeline resolves every localization key, cross-references items, businesses, buildings and recipes, and computes the economic metrics, then writes type-safe JSON and a SQLite build.
about.prov3Desc: The normalized JSON ships as static data with the site, so it loads instantly with no runtime fetch. The optional Live HQ mod layers your own save on top.
about.datasetsIntro: Every dataset, how many records it carries, and what is in it.
about.formulasIntro: The calculators use the game's own equations, mirrored from the assemblies. Three examples:
about.formulaPricingNote: The neighbourhood's social-class mix sets a price index, and a monopoly adds a bonus on top.
about.formulaMarketingNote: How much of the building a campaign network covers, as a share of its square metres.
about.formulaFactoryNote: Worker skill scales the batch, from half output to full output.
about.trustTitle: No crowdsourcing. No estimates. No cloud.
about.trustDesc: Figures are read from the game files or from your own save. Where the game records nothing, the app says so instead of guessing.

liveArchitecture.title: System Architecture
liveArchitecture.intro: A local-first companion: the game and the web app never talk through a server in the middle. Here is how the pieces fit together, what runs where, and how your data stays on your machine.
liveArchitecture.offlineLoopbackDesc: The only channel is 127.0.0.1:8765, your own machine. No company data or save names ever leave it.
liveArchitecture.readOnlySafetyDesc: The mod only serves GET requests. There are no write operations, so your save is never touched.
liveArchitecture.cachedOnDemandDesc: It rebuilds only when asked and caches day-scoped figures, so there is no per-frame stutter.
liveArchitecture.bigPictureIntro: Four layers, one direction: your game state flows out to your screen. Every optional part sits beside the pipeline, never inside it.
liveArchitecture.layerGameDesc: Unity + C#. Your whole empire lives in memory: cash, stores, staff, stock and buildings.
liveArchitecture.layerModDesc: A small C# engine reads the save, turns it into JSON and serves it over localhost.
liveArchitecture.layerLoopbackDesc: 127.0.0.1:8765. Reads only, local only. The single channel between game and app.
liveArchitecture.layerAppDesc: Next.js + React. Polls the bridge, normalizes the data and renders every dashboard.
liveArchitecture.sideCompendiumDesc: Static game data extracted from the game files.
liveArchitecture.sideAiDesc: Your own Gemini key. The browser talks to Google, only when you use the advisor.
liveArchitecture.sideVoiceDesc: Uncle Fred speaks through an online, serverless text-to-speech engine (free, nothing to install).
liveArchitecture.sideReportsDesc: A Discord form, only when you choose to send.
liveArchitecture.blocksIntro: The parts that make it work, grouped by where each one runs.
liveArchitecture.blockModDesc: One shared C# engine reads SaveGameManager by reflection, caches day-scoped financials and serializes JSON with Newtonsoft.
liveArchitecture.blockBridgeDesc: An embedded HttpListener on 127.0.0.1:8765 answers GET and OPTIONS only, with CORS and Private Network Access headers so a secure page can reach localhost.
liveArchitecture.blockTargetsDesc: The Steam Workshop native mod and the MelonLoader standalone compile the same engine into two DLLs, so behaviour is identical.
liveArchitecture.blockWebDesc: Next.js App Router, React and TypeScript. One context polls the bridge, normalizes a typed state, caches it for instant reloads and feeds every view.
liveArchitecture.blockDataDesc: Items, businesses, buildings, districts and suppliers pulled from the game into static JSON, plus the calculation engines that use them.
liveArchitecture.blockAiDesc: Bring your own Gemini key. The browser sends a compact empire summary straight to Google, only while you chat with the advisor.
liveArchitecture.blockVoiceDesc: Uncle Fred speaks through a serverless XTTS text-to-speech engine in the cloud (free, nothing to install), with a local fallback for development.
liveArchitecture.blockReportsDesc: Bug and suggestion reports post to Discord through a bot, with a privacy-scrubbed snapshot and optional in-game diagnostics.
liveArchitecture.flow1: The game updates its in-memory state as you play.
liveArchitecture.flow2: It asks the bridge for the latest over loopback, at your chosen cadence.
liveArchitecture.flow3: Only when needed, reading the save and reusing day-scoped caches.
liveArchitecture.flow4: Serialized to JSON and returned. Nothing is written to disk.
liveArchitecture.flow5: The app normalizes, caches and re-renders the dashboards.
liveArchitecture.stackModDesc: Runs inside the game and serves the data over localhost.
liveArchitecture.stackModItems: C# / .NET Framework 4.7.2, Unity, HttpListener, Newtonsoft.Json, MelonLoader + Steam Workshop native
liveArchitecture.stackWebDesc: The interface you use in the browser.
liveArchitecture.stackWebItems: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
liveArchitecture.stackServicesDesc: Optional online extras, off unless you use them.
liveArchitecture.stackServicesItems: Vercel (hosting), Google Gemini (AI, your key), Modal (voice), Discord (reports)
liveArchitecture.safety1Desc: Only GET and OPTIONS exist. There are no POST, PUT, DELETE or file-write endpoints anywhere.
liveArchitecture.safety2Desc: The mod never writes to disk. Uninstall it and your save is exactly as the game left it.
liveArchitecture.safety3Desc: CORS and Private Network Access headers let the app talk to localhost from any modern browser.
liveArchitecture.safety4Desc: The full mod source is public on GitHub for anyone to inspect.
liveArchitecture.safety5Desc: Subscribe natively on Steam, no manual file extraction.
liveArchitecture.privacyDesc: By default, nothing. Uncle Fred (your key), the online voice and bug reports only leave when you use them, and reports are privacy-scrubbed.
liveArchitecture.zoneLocalKey: Your own API key (if you use the AI)
liveArchitecture.zoneCloudTitle: To the internet, only on request
liveArchitecture.zoneCloudAi: Uncle Fred prompt to Google, with your key
liveArchitecture.zoneCloudVoice: Voice text to the voice service
liveArchitecture.zoneCloudReports: Bug or suggestion report to Discord
liveArchitecture.neverCollectedDesc: Your save file name, any account or identity (there is no login), or your game data on our servers.

liveArchitecture.releaseDesc: The mod reports its version to the app. The Steam Workshop mod (BigAmbitionsCompanionMod.dll) and the MelonLoader standalone (AmbitionProSync.dll) share one engine and one version.

districts.title: District Atlas
districts.subtitle: Social-class demographics, real estate multipliers, and price-index baselines for every NYC district.
districts.priceIndexBody: Each social class tolerates a different price ceiling: Working 1.20x, Middle 1.40x, Upper 1.70x the base market price. A district average price index is the share-weighted mean of these.

banking.title: Banking & Investment Guide
banking.subtitle: How loans, daily interest, and investment funds work in Big Ambitions.
banking.banksDesc: Two banks offer loans and investment funds. Visit in person or call them from your Contacts app.
banking.dailyInterestFormula: amount x rate / days per year
banking.dailyInterestNote: Charged on top of the principal payment.
banking.termFormula: years to pay x days per year
banking.termNote: A year is 60 in-game days by default.
banking.minPayment: You may lower the daily payment to a minimum of 50% of the standard amount (still at least $5).
banking.interestMultiplier: Bank interest scales with the difficulty setting via the Bank Interest Multiplier (default 1.0x).
banking.investmentsDesc: Each fund has a range of possible earnings that fluctuates daily. Your balance is the initial deposit plus any extra investment, minus withdrawals, plus accumulated interest.
banking.lowRiskDesc: Almost always earns money, but grows slowly.
banking.highRiskDesc: Can earn faster, but carries a real risk of losing money.
banking.autoInvest: Enable auto-invest to automatically contribute a set amount to a fund. Manage loans and investments from the EconoView app on your BizPhone.

workforce.title: Workforce & Education Compendium
workforce.subtitle: Business school diplomas, employee skills, and how worker skill scales output.
workforce.diplomasDesc: Completed at the Manhattan Business School. Several diplomas gate higher-tier businesses, offices, and factories.
workforce.skillFormulaDesc: A factory worker at 0% skill produces 50% of the base batch. At 100% skill they produce the full amount. Train employees to raise their primary skill and output.
workforce.jobDemandsDesc: Employees request perks and conditions. Fulfill them to keep morale high and prevent them from being poached by rivals.
workforce.demandScheduleDesc: Days per week, time of day, and weekend preferences.
workforce.demandInsuranceDesc: Bronze, silver, or gold coverage plans.
workforce.demandEquipmentDesc: Desks, chairs, monitors, computers, phones, and coffee machines.
workforce.demandEnvironmentDesc: Clean workplaces, peaceful settings, and no cleaning duties.
